description: This file defines the HttpClient class responsible for handling HTTP file downloads using libcurl, including rate limiting, progress tracking, and SSL configuration placeholders. It also includes a utility class for tracing function entry and exit.

classes.name: HttpClient
classes.description: A class providing HTTP download capabilities with progress, rate limiting, and SSL configuration placeholders.

classes.name: trace_exit
classes.description: A utility class for tracing function entry and exit for debugging purposes.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file from a URL with optional rate limiting.

methods.name: setRateLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum receive speed for the download.

methods.name: getProgress
methods.description: Returns the current progress of the download.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the last request.
